#ObserverName coordinate is given in the HelioGraphic Carrington coordinate system HGC (R,CRLT,CRLN).
#ObserverName is the center of Helioprojective coordinate system HPC (DIST,HPLT,HPLN).

#nVersion
#Rsun(m)
#ObserverTime
